notes: Full Phase-1 sales data-cleaning pipeline (dedup by customer_id+order_id, dual-format date parsing with yymmdd10./ddmmyy10., ship-before-order + missing-ship flagging, product_category/region standardization, numeric sanity edits, email validation, catx flag column). Two edits vs. upstream: (1) the hardcoded SAS OnDemand PROC IMPORT path is replaced with an inline DATALINES step carrying the same 15 sample rows and column types so the bundle is self-contained; (2) the terminal PROC EXPORT to a hardcoded path is replaced with a PROC PRINT of the final table so the cleaned result is visible in the listing. Sample dates are the same rows shifted uniformly back five years (2023->2018 etc.) so every row stays on the near side of the script's own order_dt > today() future-date check; all edge cases (duplicate C002 pair, ddmmyy row C004, ship-before-order C001/C013, missing ship C003, category/region/email variants) are preserved. Cleaning logic, PROC options, and output semantics are unchanged from the author's code.
